improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring criteria, such as sentiment analysis or audience retention metrics, to improve scoring accuracy and relevance.
Enhance filtering capabilities by supporting multi-select filters or advanced query options for more granular control.
Upgrade data persistence to IndexedDB for better scalability and handling of larger datasets.
Include wireframes or mockups to visually represent the GUI design for better clarity and alignment with user expectations.
Expand smoke tests to include edge cases, such as importing extremely large datasets or handling unexpected user inputs.

payload.quality_target: Enhance scalability, advanced filtering, and scoring capabilities while maintaining simplicity and modularity.
